description: This file contains utility functions for JSON communication and gRPC connection handling within the operator package, including error handling, HTTP response helpers, and device connection setup.

methods.name: ReplyError
methods.description: Logs an error message and sends it as a JSON ErrorMsg via the JSONConn connection.

methods.name: ReplyJSONOK
methods.description: Sends a JSON response with a success HTTP status code.

methods.name: ReplyJSONErr
methods.description: Logs an error and sends an appropriate JSON error response, differentiating between application-specific errors and internal errors.

methods.name: ReplyJSON
methods.description: Sends a generic JSON response with a specified HTTP status code.

methods.name: ConnectControlEnvProxyServer
methods.description: Establishes a gRPC connection to the ControlEnvProxyServer for a specified device based on the device pool.
